summary: ## User Guide This guide is intended to give an elementary description of ripgrep and an overview of its capabilities. This guide assumes that ripgrep is [installed](README.md#installation) and that readers have passing familiarity with using command line tools. This also assumes a Unix-like system, although most commands are probably easily translatable to any command line shell environment. ### Table of Contents * [Basics](#basics) * [Recursive search](#recursive-search)
